open_points.subject: execute_trial_case file output digest
open_points.text: - execute_trial_case: [BEHAVIOR] The outcome is the sandbox outcome of the same name; a succeeded execution is passed when the case has no expected outputs or every output's digest equals the expected one — a value output's digest is content_identity of a BytesContent holding its canonical bytes and a file output's is its content_digest, both computed from what the sandbox returned, and an expected output's is read from its stored record; the outcome is decided before any output is written, so no output is read back from the store —, a many file output equal only with the same length and equal digests position by position, and output_mismatch otherwise; a succeeded value output whose canonical bytes exceed the imported RELEASE_CEILING_STORED_VALUE_BYTES_MAX constant makes the outcome contract_violation.
open_points.other_text: - FilePayload fields (exact, no others exist): content: bytes, payload_kind: Literal['file'], port: str
open_points.question: Must FilePayload gain a content_digest field, or must the behavior require computing the file digest from its content bytes?
